content:
incident-bot: PAGER -> @oncall-sre: High error rate (5xx) & trace ingestion lag for tenant 'hearthco-prod' in Dedicated pool eu-west-1. Alert: tenant-forwarder-rate-limiter-exceeded.

oncall-sre: I'm awake — acknowledging. Starting triage. What's the customer impact? Are logs/traces missing or just delayed?

emma: seeing dropped spans for hearthco-prod across multiple services. Traces stop around 2024-11-02T09:42Z. Metrics show a sudden drop in span_count for that tenant. Logs are present in the raw bucket but the forwarder is returning 429s.

raj: adding context: the per-tenant forwarder has a token-based quota. Rate limiter started returning `RATE_LIMITED` when the forwarder spike hit. Looks like a burst of retries from the ingestion cluster triggered throttling.

lia: Customer-eng called: hearthco is seeing partial loss in request tracing for their critical payment flow. They're worried about compliance audit window. Need ETA for restore + mitigation.

platform-kay: quick mitigation option: bump token quota for hearthco-prod on the forwarder gateway for 30m, and enable temporary proxying through the shadowing pipeline to ensure spans reach the observability DB. Would need infra approval.

oncall-sre: Can we do a lighter fix first? Suggested steps: 1) identify offending retry source, 2) apply per-tenant burst allowance, 3) enable proxy as fallback. I'll start 1 and 2.

raj: found spike origin: ingestion worker set `MAX_RETRY=8` after yesterday's deploy; traces requeued heavily for a few partitions. Patch candidate: revert retry change or add jitter + capped concurrency for tenant shards.

emma: repro log snippet from forwarder:
```
2024-11-02T09:42:13Z WARN forwarder tenant=hearthco-prod code=RATE_LIMITED details="token quota exceeded"
2024-11-02T09:42:14Z ERROR forwarder tenant=hearthco-prod retry=3 err="upstream 429"
```

lia: customer-eng requests that we confirm whether logs will be available for the audit if we proxy. They'll need an explicit affirmation.

oncall-sre: Actioning - increasing hearthco-prod token quota by +50% for 40m (will monitor). Also adding a temporary rule to route hearthco-prod spans via `observability-proxy-2` on eu-west-1. Executing now.

(platform-kay): note: applying quota bump requires a secrets rotation for the forwarder auth header in the gateway. Doing a hot-rotate with no restart.

10m later — oncall-sre: Quota bump applied. Proxy route enabled. I'm seeing span ingestion resume for hearthco-prod (span_count trending up). No 429s in the last 2m.

customer-eng: passing update to HearthCo — they confirm traces are reappearing in their UI for the payment flow. They still want root cause and assurance for audit.

raj: temporary mitigation validated. Next steps: revert `MAX_RETRY=8` change in ingestion workers, add per-tenant retry cap + jitter, and add alerting rule to fire before forwarder token exhaustion (predictive threshold). I'll open a PR.

oncall-sre: I'm creating an incident timeline and assigning postmortem to @raj and @emma. Also paging infra owner to review hot-rotate impact and ensure the proxy route doesn't mask token shortage for other tenants.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to sev2. Paging schedule updated.

lia: hearthco legal asked for formal confirmation that all missing traces during the window were replayed and are now present. Can we export a verification report?

emma: yes — running a query across the span store to list span_id counts by minute for hearthco-prod between 09:30-10:10Z and comparing to raw bucket counts. Will attach report to the postmortem.

oncall-sre: Final note: mitigation holds, customer impact reduced to near-zero. Keeping open until revert + PR merged. If no regression in 60m, we'll close and start postmortem writeup.

platform-kay: followups: (1) add predictive token-exhaustion metric + runbook, (2) make quota bump workflow auditable (who/why), (3) harden forwarder to prefer proxy fallback automatically when token errors spike.

raj: PR opened:  https://git.internal/repo/ingestion/commit/df9a2 -> revert retry change + add capped per-tenant concurrency.

2h later — oncall-sre: Closing incident thread; mitigation stable and PR merged. Postmortem assigned to raj/emma/lia. Customer-facing summary will be prepared by customer-eng.

customer-eng: Confirmed HearthCo acknowledged the update and will await the formal RCA. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
